changes: Released 2026-11-26 (XC_VM-GO, unofficial fork based on XC_VM 2.7.4).

CPU fix for live channels in Go: an HLS source with separate audio (video and audio in different playlists) leaked one background task per second; after a few hours one channel could use dozens of CPU cores. Fixed.
Go live channels now use at most 4 threads each, and their memory limit grows with real use instead of a fixed 48 MB (a fixed limit made memory cleanup run non-stop).
Same binary for on-demand (odrelay) and live (ffmpeg-golive). Updating restarts odrelay once (on-demand viewers reconnect); live channels pick up the fix at their next (re)start.
Includes everything from 2.7.4-p3: Go is the default for live channels, Go replaces FFmpeg for all on-demand channels.
